facts.fact: 本章以拍卖图录条目开场（框架叙事）：Lot 7《Mating for Life》，Nancy Caswell 作，1969年7月——Ambrose 与 Irene Bramley（née Mott）在 head gardener’s cottage 厨房拍摄的黑白合影，35mm 胶片、由 Nancy 在 Rushwood 酒窖的临时暗房冲洗，系列之一、背面签名并标题。
facts.anchor: Black-and-white photographic portrait of Ambrose and Irene Bramley (née Mott) in the head gardener’s cottage kitchen

facts.fact: Pa 把玻璃杯狠摔在桌上（啤酒沫漫出杯沿），痛斥 Miriam 去给 Whipple 打帮手是‘愚蠢、自私的分心’——讥她想‘scamper after that poncy bloke in a cravat’、去‘Plump Lady Muck’s pillows’；Miriam 自觉生错了家庭、生错了人生，决意不被父亲击垮。
facts.anchor: Pa slammed down his glass so hard on the table the beer’s foamy froth slid over the rim

facts.fact: Pa 拍桌宣告‘The Bramleys have always been gardeners’‘the soil’s in your veins too’，并断言‘Young women like you don’t get to choose, Miriam.’；Miriam 斗胆反问 Why not me?；Pa 喝令 Irene 劝女儿，Irene 慢慢表态同意 Pa，Miriam 心气一沉。
facts.anchor: Young women like you don’t get to choose, Miriam.

facts.fact: Irene 擦干手转身支招：现在放 Whipple 鸽子会掀起‘right kerfuffle’——Celia 正为派对焦头烂额——Miriam 当场看穿母亲在巧妙驾驭火爆的 Pa；Alf 壮胆说‘Ma has a point’，Pamela 提议 Miriam 兼两份工；Pa 眯眼嗅出‘合谋’，仍回‘Nope… No good will come of it’。
facts.anchor: She shook her head slightly, and I realized what she was doing, how deftly she managed hot-headed Pa.

facts.fact: 厨房门被敲响：Nancy 穿白色比基尼、挎着露出黑胶片罐的卡其相机包登场（‘Evening, campers’），以‘快中暑、光线完美’为名要‘认领’ Miriam、Alf、Pamela 去泳池日落游泳；Pa 以‘They’re working this evening’拦阻，全场僵在两人之间；Nancy 借‘庆祝 Miriam 的新工作’‘You must be very proud, Mr B’拆招，Pa 低声顶回‘Miriam’s already got a job’，Ma 走到他身后轻按双肩——既安抚又警告。
facts.anchor: wearing a white bikini, heavy-duty khaki camera bag slung over a bare shoulder

facts.fact: Nancy 好奇打量黄墙（‘like old Cheddar left out on the cheeseboard too long’）与宠物鸡，掏出银黑相机绕屋连拍——偏爱裙板上老鼠的锈色血渍与天花板潮斑，‘不要求任何人微笑’；随后一把拽走 Alf（‘Come on, handsome’），又补一句‘姐妹也去’。
facts.anchor: The rat’s rusty bloodstain on the skirting board delighted her.

facts.fact: Nancy 举起盒式 Polaroid 对准父母，边拍边游说：Whipple 是‘the best in the biz. Knows everything. Everybody.’、她母亲请他来这‘backwater’还被翻了倍价钱（‘doubled his rate’）、‘Safe in taxis too’，又低语‘Not one for the ladies’——Pa 顿时脸色发白（同性恋合法才两年、他的观念至少落后十年）；她把冲出的‘你与美丽的 Mrs B’照片送给 Pa，Pa 从呆滞到熊式大笑‘Some sort of magic, eh?’；Nancy 朝 Miriam 投去得胜一笑，趁 Pa 心情松动带三兄妹去泳池。
facts.anchor: extracting a boxy Polaroid camera, then levelling it at my parents.

facts.fact: 临行 Ma 以‘quiet, steely courage’叮嘱：‘明早要上新班就别玩到太晚，Mim’；Pa 张口欲抗议，Ma 俯身吻他脸颊堵了回去；母女对视中 Miriam 看出 Ma 心怀不安——预感‘our summer setting fast, like the Polaroid on the table’；烤箱里布丁烧焦、冒出一缕黑烟——‘the first hint of fire’。
facts.anchor: the scorching smell of the pudding burning, a wisp of black smoke, the first hint of fire.

relations.pair: Miriam ↔ Pa（Mr B＝Ambrose Bramley，图录点名）
relations.relation: 父女正面冲突：Pa 信仰园丁世家、待人‘非友即敌’，把 Miriam 帮 Whipple 视为对其阶级与 Ambrose 式家长世界的背叛，断言‘你有一天会感谢我’；Miriam 坚拒就范。
relations.anchor: With Pa, you were either with him or against him, no middle ground.

relations.relation: 母女：Irene 先表态站队丈夫，随即巧计斡旋放行；临别叮嘱之余与 Miriam 对视——Miriam 看出母亲不安，预感这个夏天正在飞速‘定格’。
relations.anchor: sensing our summer setting fast, like the Polaroid on the table

relations.relation: 兄妹同盟：Alf 壮胆称‘Ma has a point’，Pamela 提议‘Miriam 兼两份工’替她缓颊。
relations.anchor: Miriam will just have to do two jobs, won’t she?

relations.relation: Nancy 替 Mother 撑场面：请 Whipple 来是她的‘coup’（还接受他翻倍价钱）；又透露‘Frank the wrecking ball’出局后 Mother ‘happy, well, calmer at least. And nothing to do with Quaaludes!’——真假难辨。
relations.anchor: knowing Frank the wrecking ball is out of the picture

relations.relation: 由对峙到收服：一张 Polaroid 让 Pa 转怒为喜，Nancy 把照片相赠、许诺‘35mm 冲出好片子也归你’，并趁热打铁带走三兄妹。
Miriam 的机会是为 Whipple 打下手；Nancy 称他‘the best in the biz’、‘not one for the ladies’（Pa 闻之变色）；Pa 则贬为‘poncy bloke in a cravat’。
relations.anchor: Whipple’s the best in the biz. Knows everything. Everybody.

relations.relation: Lawrence 的大学朋友 Rafe 已抵达——‘去年被 Oxford sent down（勒令退学）’；Nancy 评他‘Very naughty. Lots of fun.’但‘像烈伏特加需要掺水’，Pamela 闻之色变。
Pa 提到 Harold：‘No one has a good word to say down the Feathers.’，不知何故、只盼‘晚点知道’——伏笔式不安。
relations.anchor: No one has a good word to say down the Feathers.

relations.relation: Pa 视 Celia 为不留情面的雇主：‘She’ll sack me over a bit of black spot’、‘no second chances’、‘We’re expendable’，还讽她‘Celia Caswell is no Lady Mellors’。
relations.anchor: She’ll sack me over a bit of black spot.

relations.relation: Nancy 顺口透露主宅规矩：‘Doris won’t allow it in the main house’（身份未明、却连乱糟糟都不许有）。
relations.anchor: Doris won’t allow it in the main house.

relations.relation: Nancy Caswell 1969年7月作品《Mating for Life》即 Ambrose 与 Irene Bramley（née Mott）在 head gardener’s cottage 厨房的黑白照——正是本章厨房里的 Pa 与 Ma；Nancy 在 Rushwood 酒窖暗房冲洗、系列之一、背面签名标题。
relations.anchor: Lot 7: ‘Mating for Life’ by Nancy Caswell, July 1969.

同性恋合法仅两年（‘Homosexuality had only been legal two years’）
Pa 的观念至少落后十年（‘Pa’s sensibility was at least a decade behind’）

turning_point: Nancy 端着 Polaroid 闯入，以相赠照片和‘庆祝 Miriam 新工作’瓦解 Pa 的否决、带走三兄妹——家庭‘共同阵线’被撕开第一道口子；结尾布丁烧焦的一缕黑烟（‘the first hint of fire’）按下不祥伏笔。
